candidate.text: Upgrading to `1.0.0`+: Karpenter `1.0.0` introduces v1 APIs, including _significant_ changes to the API and upgrade procedures for the Karpenter controllers. Do not upgrade to `1.0.0`+ without referencing the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure. This version adds conversion webhooks to automatically pull the v1 API version of previously applied v1beta1 NodePools, EC2NodeClasses, and NodeClaims. Karpenter will stop serving the v1beta1 API version at v1.1.0 and will drop the conversion webhooks at that time. Migrate all stored manifests to v1 API versions on Karpenter v1.0+. Below is the full changelog for v1, copied from the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure.

evidence.excerpt:
